tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check if the server is responsive

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all open browser pages with their page_id, URL, and title.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Close a browser tab. Use list_pages first to get the page_id.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL. Returns page snapshot with interactive elements.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate to, including the scheme (e.g. https://example.com).

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back one page in browser history. Returns a fresh page snapshot of the resulting page with its interactive elements.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Go forward one page in browser history. Returns a fresh page snapshot of the resulting page with its interactive elements.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Refresh the current page. Use after a change that only takes effect on reload, or to recover from a stale page. Returns a fresh page snapshot with its interactive elements.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Re-capture the page state without performing any action. Use when the page may have changed on its own (timers, live updates, animations).

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Locate elements or read page text without acting on them. Two modes: filter by `kind`/`label`/`region` to find interactive elements (returns each match with a stable `eid` for use with click, type, select, etc.), or set `include_readable` to also get text content tagged with semantic `rd-*` ids. Best for pinpointing a target before an action or pulling specific content; use snapshot for the whole page. Returns matching elements/content as XML.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to search within.

kind.description: Filter by element type: 'button' for clickable buttons, 'link' for hyperlinks, 'textbox' for input fields, 'checkbox'/'radio' for toggles, 'combobox' for dropdowns, 'heading' for section titles, 'image' for images, 'canvas' for canvas elements, 'alert' for notifications/toasts/alerts/status messages.

label.description: Search text to match against element labels - uses case-insensitive substring matching. Example: label "Sign" matches "Sign In", "Sign Up", "Signature".

region.description: Restrict search to a specific area.

include_readable.description: When true (default), text content (paragraphs, headings) gets semantic IDs (rd-*) for reference. Set to true when you need to read page content. Use the `kind` parameter to filter to specific element types.

tools.name: get_element
tools.description: Get complete details for one element: exact position, size, state, and attributes. Requires an `eid` obtained from find or snapshot. Use when you need precise geometry or full attribute/state data for a single element. Returns the element details as XML.

eid.description: Element ID to inspect, obtained from find results or the page snapshot.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page or a specific element. Use for visual verification or when layout/rendering matters; prefer snapshot or find for reading structure and text. Returns the image inline, or a file path when the image is large.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to screenshot.

eid.description: Element ID to screenshot. Requires a prior snapshot. Cannot be combined with fullPage.

fullPage.description: Capture full page height beyond the viewport. Cannot be combined with eid.

format.description: Image format: 'png' (lossless, default) or 'jpeg' (lossy with quality control).

quality.description: JPEG quality 0-100. Only applies when format is jpeg.

tools.name: scroll_to
tools.description: Scroll until a specific element (by `eid`) is visible in the viewport. Use before clicking or reading an element that find/snapshot reports as off-screen. Returns a fresh page snapshot reflecting the new scroll position.

eid.description: Element ID of the off-screen element from find results or the page snapshot.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the viewport up or down by a pixel amount. Use to reveal more of a long page or trigger lazy-loaded content; use scroll_to when you know the target element. Returns a fresh page snapshot reflecting the new scroll position.

direction.description: Direction to scroll the viewport: 'up' or 'down'.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element (by `eid`) or at viewport coordinates. Prefer `eid` for reliability; use coordinates only for canvas or non-semantic targets. Returns a fresh page snapshot with the changes the click produced.

page_id.description: The ID of the page containing the element.

eid.description: Element ID from find results or the page snapshot. Every interactive element has a unique eid.

x.description: X coordinate for the click. When used with eid, relative to the element top-left corner. When used without eid, absolute viewport coordinate.

y.description: Y coordinate for the click. When used with eid, relative to the element top-left corner. When used without eid, absolute viewport coordinate.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during the click (e.g., Shift for multi-select, Control for ctrl-click).

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into an input field or text area (by `eid`). Set `clear` to replace existing content instead of appending. Returns a fresh page snapshot reflecting the updated field and any resulting changes (validation, autocomplete, etc.).

text.description: The text to type into the element.

eid.description: Element ID of the input field from find results or the page snapshot.

clear.description: If true, clear the field before typing (replaces content). If false (default), append to existing text.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: press
tools.description: Press a single keyboard key with optional modifiers, dispatched to the focused element. Use for submitting with Enter, dismissing with Escape, or keyboard navigation (Tab, arrows); use type to enter text. Returns a fresh page snapshot with any resulting changes.

key.description: Key to press on the focused element, e.g. Enter to submit, Escape to dismiss, Tab to move focus, or the arrow keys to navigate.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold while the key is pressed (e.g. Control, Shift).

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Choose an option from a dropdown menu by value or visible text.

eid.description: Element ID of the dropdown from find results or the page snapshot.

value.description: The option to select - can be either the value attribute or the visible text of the option.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move mouse over an element without clicking. Triggers hover menus and tooltips.

eid.description: Element ID from find results or the page snapshot.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from a source point to a target point (optionally relative to an element via `eid`). Use for reordering lists, moving sliders/handles, or manipulating canvas objects. Returns a fresh page snapshot with any resulting changes.

source_x.description: X coordinate of the drag start point.

source_y.description: Y coordinate of the drag start point.

target_x.description: X coordinate of the drag end point.

target_y.description: Y coordinate of the drag end point.

eid.description: Optional element ID. When provided, coordinates are relative to the element top-left corner.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during the drag (e.g., Shift for constrained rotation, Control for copy-drag).

page_id.description: The ID of the page.

tools.name: wheel
tools.description: Dispatch a mouse wheel event at specific coordinates. Use for scroll-to-zoom (with Control modifier) or horizontal scrolling.

x.description: X coordinate where the wheel event is dispatched.

y.description: Y coordinate where the wheel event is dispatched.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in pixels. Positive scrolls right.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in pixels. Positive scrolls down, negative scrolls up. For zoom: negative typically zooms in, positive zooms out.

eid.description: Optional element ID. When provided, x/y coordinates are relative to the element top-left corner.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during the wheel event (e.g., Control for zoom).

page_id.description: The ID of the page.

tools.name: inspect_canvas
tools.description: Analyze a canvas element: auto-detect the rendering library, query its scene graph, and return an annotated screenshot with coordinate grid overlay.

eid.description: Element ID of the canvas element from find results.

grid_spacing.description: Grid line spacing in pixels (default: 50). Smaller values give finer coordinate resolution.

format.description: Image format: 'png' (lossless, default) or 'jpeg' (lossy with quality control).

quality.description: JPEG quality 0-100. Only applies when format is jpeg.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Analyze all forms on the page: fields, required inputs, validation rules, and field dependencies. Call this first on any multi-field or multi-step form to plan the fill order, instead of scrolling and screenshotting. Returns each form as XML with per-field eids, state, constraints, and the suggested next field to fill.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

form_id.description: Restrict the result to a single form by its id (from a prior get_form call). If omitted, all forms on the page are returned.

include_values.description: When true, include each field's current value in the response. Defaults to false; sensitive values (passwords, tokens) remain masked even when enabled.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: Get detailed info about one form field (by `eid`): purpose, valid input formats, dependencies, and suggested values. Use to resolve a field get_form flagged as ambiguous or invalid before typing into it. Returns the field context as XML including constraints, options, and dependencies.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

eid.description: Element ID of the form field to inspect, from get_form or the page snapshot.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Extract the main readable content from the page, removing navigation, ads, and clutter. Uses Mozilla Readability (Firefox Reader View engine). Best for articles, blog posts, documentation, and content-heavy pages.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

tools.name: list_network_calls
tools.description: List HTTP requests and responses made by the page. Filter by resource type, method, status code, or URL pattern; supports pagination. Use after navigate or an action to inspect API traffic, confirm a request fired, or find failing calls (e.g. status_min=400). Returns request/response summaries as XML.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type: xhr, fetch, document, script, stylesheet, image, font, media, other.

method.description: Filter by HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, etc.

status_min.description: Minimum HTTP status code (inclusive). Use 400 to see only errors.

status_max.description: Maximum HTTP status code (inclusive). Use with status_min for ranges like 200-299.

failed_only.description: When true, only show requests that failed due to network errors.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100).

tools.name: search_network_calls
tools.description: Search network calls by URL pattern (substring or regex). Use when you know part of the endpoint URL and want just those calls, optionally with headers and request body; use list_network_calls to browse all traffic. Returns matching requests as XML with optional headers and body details.

page_id.description: Page ID. If omitted, operates on the most recently used page.

url_pattern.description: URL pattern to search for. Substring match by default; set url_regex=true for regex.

url_regex.description: When true, url_pattern is treated as a regular expression.

include_headers.description: When true, include request and response headers in results.

include_body.description: When true, include POST body in results.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100).
